// ============================================================
// RSQ Wheel -- MENUDEF
// ============================================================
//
// REMA's weapon wheel, under the series' one Options entry (owner 11-04 19:36): ONE page with every
// option under short headers (the old Picking, Ring and Cards and Data Sheet pages folded in), then
// Test and Debug for the raw numbers and Reset All (the series' RSQWHResetAll row; KEYCONF's wr_reset stays
// for configs, generated by tools/gen_reset.py).
//
// NOT IN THE MENU, ON PURPOSE (their cvars stay, so a config or REMA can still set them): what
// does nothing on stock QuestZDoom 17.3 (wr_q_shim.zs answers it with a no-op). The engine's
// native wheel (wr_suppress_native_wheel), the room effects (wr_vbeam*, wr_sweep*, wr_fog*,
// wr_floor*, wr_wave*), painted card faces (wr_canvas*, wr_scan_crawl), the SDF plate and its
// glow (wr_sdf, wr_glow, wr_plate_radius, wr_plate_border), and the weapon-mod readers that
// only read another mod's fields by name (Doomablo, DOOM Infinite, Pandemonia, Guncaster,
// BorderDoom: wr_dbl/di/pand/gc/bd_compat). The gun cards are their own mod, RSQ Gun Cards.

// ---- Radiant Silvergun Options (tools/rsmenu) ----------------------------------------------------
// The series' one Options entry. Every series pk3 carries this same block with its own prefix: the
// parent is PROTECTED, so the first definition stays and later ones add nothing (QZD 17.3 merges a
// protected option menu instead of replacing it); the link row removes any earlier copy of itself,
// so Options shows one row however many series pk3s load. Each mod then adds its own row only.
OptionMenu "RSQ_RSOptions" protected
{
	Class "RSQWH_RSMenu"
	Title "RADIANT SILVERGUN OPTIONS"
}

AddOptionMenu "OptionsMenu"
{
	RSQWHRSLink "Radiant Silvergun Options", "RSQ_RSOptions"
}

AddOptionMenu "RSQ_RSOptions"
{
	Submenu "RSQ Wheel", "wr_Options"
}
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

OptionString "wr_Palettes"
{
	"Standard", "Standard"
	"Doom",     "Doom"
	"Hell",     "Hell"
	"Tech",     "Tech"
}

OptionString "wr_FontSets"
{
	"Score",     "RSQ Score's font"
	"Combo",     "RSQ Score's combo font"
	"JFO",       "JFO"
	"StatusBar", "Status bar numerals"
	"SmallGold", "Small gold numerals"
	"SmallGrey", "Small grey numerals"
	"DoomFont",  "DoomFont only"
	"Ermac",     "Ermac's digits"
}

OptionValue "wr_RingArt"
{
	0, "Its own (Ermac style)"
	1, "Status bar stone"
}

OptionValue "wr_WheelMode"
{
	1, "On"
	0, "Off"
}

// Which hand the Open Wheel key opens the ring in front of (with Either Hand Picks on, both hands still pick).
OptionValue wr_ToggleHandPref
{
	0,  "Main hand"
	1,  "Off hand"
}

// What a crowded slot unfolds into: the fan (three lanes stacked outward) or stars round the card.
OptionValue wr_FanStyle
{
	0, "Fan"
	1, "Constellation"
}

// Slot colour first: the burst comes out the card's own hue, so it confirms which one you hit.
OptionValue wr_SparkColors
{
	0, "Slot colour"
	1, "White hot"
	2, "Rainbow"
}

// LED first: it survives a dark room, which is where this mostly gets used.
OptionValue wr_Readouts
{
	0, "LED segments"
	1, "LCD, punched out"
	2, "Lozenge badge"
}

OptionValue wr_WebView
{
	0, "Marine"
	1, "Mirror"
}

OptionValue wr_CardLook
{
	1, "Colour by Gun"
	0, "Classic"
}

OptionMenu wr_Options
{
	Title "RSQ WHEEL"
	// wr_wheel_mode is mirrored onto wr_suppress_native_wheel (REMA) as (mode != 2), so Off never
	// hands back an engine wheel.
	Option "Weapon Wheel",              "wr_wheel_mode",   "wr_WheelMode"
	Option "Either Hand Picks",         "wr_either_hand",  "OnOff"
	Option "Opens On",                  "wr_toggle_prefer_hand", "wr_ToggleHandPref"
	Option "Sound",                     "wr_sound",        "OnOff"
	// vr_enable_haptics still overrules this.
	Slider "Controller Rumble",         "wr_haptics",      0.0, 2.0, 0.1, 1
	Slider "Size",                      "wr_scale",        0.3, 3.0, 0.05, 2
	StaticText " "
	StaticText "Controls", 1
	// Hold, point either hand at a card, let go (left thumbstick click by default). Tap: stays up.
	Control "Open Wheel",               "+wr_wheel"    // hold, point, release (owner 11-10: one key; the toggles went)
	StaticText " "
	StaticText "Picking", 1
	Option "Two Hands Compare",         "wr_twohand_compare", "OnOff"
	// The ring opens with your gun's card under your hand.
	Option "Open on Your Gun",          "wr_centre_held",  "OnOff"
	// Forearm up across the chest, as if checking a watch: that hand's gun shows its card.
	// RSQ Gun Cards' own watch card takes over when that mod is loaded and its watch card is on.
	Option "Wrist Card",                "wr_watch",        "OnOff"
	Option "Open at Level Start",       "wr_autoopen",     "OnOff"
	// RSQ SlowMo when loaded (this row); without it, Freeze Without SlowMo below (on its own).
	Option "Slow Time While Open",      "wr_bullettime",   "OnOff"
	Option "Closing Ends SlowMo",       "wr_slowmo_cancel", "OnOff"
	// Without RSQ SlowMo: the ring stops time itself while it is open.
	Option "Freeze Without SlowMo",     "wr_own_freeze",   "OnOff"
	// The ring stops time while it is open, with or without RSQ SlowMo (owner 2026-11-06).
	Option "Freeze Time While Open",    "wr_freeze",       "OnOff"
	Slider "Pull a Card Out",           "wr_pull_speed",   0.0, 4.0, 0.1, 1
	Slider "Throw a Gun Back",          "wr_throw_speed",  0.0, 5.0, 0.1, 1
	// How far in front of or behind the cards your hand may be and still touch one.
	Slider "Reach In",                  "wr_touch",        0.0, 20.0, 0.5, 1
	Slider "Feel Each Gun's Weight",    "wr_weight_feel",  0.0, 1.0, 0.1, 1
	StaticText " "
	StaticText "Look", 1
	Option "Palette",                   "wr_palette",      "wr_Palettes"
	Option "Font",                      "wr_fontset",      "wr_FontSets"
	Option "Ring Plates",               "wr_ring_art",     "wr_RingArt"
	// Colour by Gun: each card in its gun's colour (RSQ Gun Cards' colours), lit stone, halos, the lock-on mark,
	// a light round the ring. Classic: the ring as it was. Colour Blind Mode (RSQ Accessibility): cards neutral,
	// only the hovered one coloured.
	Option "Card Look",                 "wr_look2",        "wr_CardLook"
	// The holster web (main-hand alt-fire on a card): the marine, or RSQ Tactical Rig's mirror of you.
	Option "Web View",                  "wr_web_view",     "wr_WebView"
	// The gun's pickup voxel (BD_VoxelPack) turning on its card; a gun without one keeps its icon.
	Option "Gun Models on Cards",       "wr_models",       "OnOff"
	Option "Ammo Counts",               "wr_ammo",         "OnOff"
	Option "Ammo Readout",              "wr_readout",      "wr_Readouts"
	Option "Rarity Colours",            "wr_tier_color",   "OnOff"
	Option "Mark Guns You Hold",        "wr_marker",       "OnOff"
	Option "Slot Numbers",              "wr_slotnum",      "OnOff"
	Option "Cards Face You",            "wr_facing",       "OnOff"
	Option "Crowded Slot Opens As",     "wr_constellation", "wr_FanStyle"
	Option "Hover Halo Breathes",       "wr_breathe",      "OnOff"
	Option "Edge Sweep",                "wr_edge_sweep",   "OnOff"
	Option "Flash on Pick",             "wr_flash",        "OnOff"
	Option "Spark Colour",              "wr_spark_color",  "wr_SparkColors"
	// One light, on the hovered card only.
	Option "Hover Lights the Room",     "wr_light",        "OnOff"
	Slider "Background Stars",          "wr_stars",        0, 200, 10, 0
	StaticText " "
	StaticText "Data Sheet", 1
	// Every reader here is ON by default and costs nothing when its mod is absent: no field, no row.
	Option "Show Data Sheet",           "wr_sheet",        "OnOff"
	Option "Weapon Stats",              "wr_sheet_stats",  "OnOff"
	// Counted by this mod as you play, so it works on every weapon.
	Option "Track Kills and Accuracy",  "wr_stats_track",  "OnOff"
	Option "This Level's Kills",        "wr_level_stats",  "OnOff"
	// With Gun Bonsai and RSQ Gun Bonsai VR loaded.
	Option "Gun Bonsai Rows",           "wr_sheet_bonsai", "OnOff"
	// Point at a gun on the floor and the sheet shows it, against what that hand holds.
	Option "Point at a Gun",            "wr_inspect",      "OnOff"
	Option "Compare With Yours",        "wr_inspect_delta", "OnOff"
	StaticText " "
	StaticText "Other Mods", 1
	Option "LegenDoom Rarity",          "wr_ld_compat",    "OnOff"
	Option "LegenDoom Effects",         "wr_ld_effects",   "OnOff"
	// PARKED (owner 2026-11-09: "disable wheel mod support for now"): the other mods' rows are hidden and their readers
	// answer off (wr_modsupport.zs). Kept here, commented, for when support comes back:
	// Option "DoomRL Arsenal Tier",       "wr_drla_compat",  "OnOff"
	// Option "DoomRL Mod Upgrades",       "wr_drla_mods",    "OnOff"
	// Option "Combined Arms Meters",      "wr_ca_compat",    "OnOff"
	// Option "Final Doomer Set",          "wr_fd_compat",    "OnOff"
	// Option "MetaDoom Demon Keys",       "wr_meta_compat",  "OnOff"
	// Option "ModelSwapper",              "wr_ms_compat",    "OnOff"
	// Control "ModelSwapper: Main Hand",  "wr_ms_cycle_main"
	// Control "ModelSwapper: Off Hand",   "wr_ms_cycle_off"
	// Option "Lithium",                   "wr_lith_compat",  "OnOff"
	// Option "Lithium RPG Stats",         "wr_lith_acs",     "OnOff"
	StaticText " "
	Submenu "Test and Debug",           "wr_Test"
	// Reset All: every cvar a row names on both pages, plus (third argument) the ones with no row, as wr_reset does.
	RSQWHResetAll "Reset All", "Reset all RSQ Wheel settings?", "wr_suppress_native_wheel wr_vbeam wr_vbeam_inner wr_vbeam_outer wr_vbeam_density wr_vbeam_dust wr_sweep wr_sweep_reach wr_sweep_bright wr_fog wr_fog_rise wr_fog_scatter wr_sdf wr_plate_radius wr_plate_border wr_floor wr_floor_kind wr_floor_count wr_floor_space wr_floor_spin wr_floor_thick wr_floor_bright wr_floor_seam wr_canvas wr_canvas_bleed wr_canvas_shadow wr_canvas_scan wr_glow wr_wave wr_wave_len wr_wave_speed wr_wave_sharp wr_scan_crawl wr_dbl_compat wr_pand_compat wr_gc_compat wr_bd_compat wr_di_compat"
}

OptionMenu wr_Test
{
	Title "RSQ WHEEL: TEST AND DEBUG"
	// Every one is live: the next tic has it.
	StaticText "Picking", 1
	Slider "Hold to Pick (tics)",       "wr_hold_tics",    3, 35, 1, 0
	Slider "Double Tap (tics)",         "wr_doubletap",    0, 20, 1, 0
	Slider "Ring Follows Past (deg)",   "wr_follow",       0, 120, 5, 0
	// Tics, 35 a second.
	Slider "Folds After (tics)",        "wr_locktics",     35, 700, 35, 0
	// Steps of 5 so the default (25 tics) sits on the scale.
	Slider "Fold Warning (tics)",       "wr_warn_tics",    0, 105, 5, 0
	StaticText " "
	StaticText "Ring", 1
	Slider "Ring Distance Ahead",       "wr_forward",      5.0, 120.0, 1.0, 0
	Slider "Ring Radius",               "wr_radius",       1.0, 40.0, 0.5, 1
	Slider "Height Above Hand",         "wr_rise",        -8.0, 12.0, 0.5, 1
	Slider "Lean Toward You",           "wr_tilt",       -30.0, 30.0, 1.0, 0
	// Off by default: a controller reports a lot of roll just from how you hold it.
	Slider "Wrist Roll Spins the Ring", "wr_roll",         0.0, 1.0, 0.05, 2
	Slider "Stick Deadzone",            "wr_stickdead",    0.05, 0.9, 0.05, 2
